title: Towards Measuring Adversarial Twitter Interactions against Candidates in the US Midterm Elections
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the measurement and characterization of unethical online behavior, specifically 'adversarial interactions' which include harassment, threats, and toxic language in political discourse. It develops new methods to evaluate these ethically charged interactions and analyzes attacks on identity, including religious identity. The entire study is an empirical investigation into digital ethics, not just a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section.
